notes: The 1998 MIDI chart lists an 'all stops off' System Exclusive message but not its bytes; F0 00 4A 4F 48 41 53 7F F7 is the form given in later Johannus manuals. Check on your organ.

The 1998 chart says CC7 (general volume) and CC11 (expression) are transmitted but gives no value range or channel; they are mapped here on channel 1 (CC7) and the Swell channel (CC11) with the full 0-127 range. Check on your organ.
The chart gives only Program Change number ranges per division (not per stop), so stops are left unbound: use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Stop list: Johannus Sweelinck 10/20/30 user manual (July 1998), registration-example tables (each table lists every stop of the model; stop counts match the voice counts in the technical specifications): https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/39134-2CmLRJo3iH2WZp4T4YaQrAPSQh9kqdZiIzRP97erE5tDmQwmsgxkI8ziCAWZWaoJ-0/Sweelinck%2010-20-30%20usermanual.pdf

MIDI scheme: Same manual, MIDI implementation chart "Sweelinck 30" (PDF p. 34): Choir 1, Great 2, Swell 3, Pedal 4, stops 12; Program Change ranges per division only; CC7 and CC11 transmitted; all-stops-off SysEx.
